profile.headline: Software, Principal Technical Expert
profile.summary:
Experienced and innovative UI Architect / Engineer with unique set of technical skills combined with an eye for crafting applications that delight end users  and meet business  needs. Experienced in design and development of user interfaces, UX methodology, numerous client and server-side web technologies, advanced layout solutions for dynamic page flow, and action-orientated context-sensitive work-flow with strong separation between the layers.
Brings a proven track record of being able to digest, process and simplify existing software solutions.
Provides users with simpler yet more powerful experiences, using clean, layered, industry-approved architectures that help concentrate business logic in the server. Have consistently brought something new to every role – be it features, rationalization of existing functionality or plain old thinking 'out of the box'.

Specialties: UI/UX Design, Code Architectures,
JavaScript (Ext JS 3 & 4, Sencha Touch), AJAX, REST
Flex, ActionScript,
Java (Swing, SWT, JFace)
Grails, Tomcat

positions.title: Software, Principal Technical Expert
positions.locationName: Boston One Campus, 800 Federal St, Andover, MA 01810
positions.description:
Full-stack feature development on the NetBotz project.
Java 12+, Hibernate, Postgres on the backend and Angular 12+, RxJS, et al. on the client side.
Experience with the Atlassian tool chain (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket), Jenkins automation (CI/CD), Docker and AI code assist.
Embedded appliance....Java running on linux running on a 2 core ARM processor.
So performance and scaling issues and interesting hardware to support like rack handles.
ONVIF Camera MJPEG streams with motion detect.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Software Design · Performance Improvement · Performance Tuning · Performance Testing · Test-Driven Development · Code Refactoring · Java · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Jersey · Bootstrap (Framework) · TypeScript · Maven · Docker · Angular · User Interface Design · Complexity Reduction · Quality Code

positions.title: UI Architect
positions.description:
Working on Nectar's advanced Unified Communications Management Platform (UCMP).
Modernizing Nectar's UI's using best practices and an overriding goal to simplify after detailed analysis.
Responsible for integrating Unified Communication Diagnostics (UCD) and Call Analysis (CAM) systems into Nectar's UCF so that users have a single interface to everything Nectar.
Responsible for all things UI.
Design and prototyping new web clients.
Java, JavaScript, AngularJS, jQuery, YUI, Sencha ExtJS, DropWizard/Jersey, REST, Swing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on SilverRail's web UI.
jQuery, Bootstrap, {{ mustache }}, Java.
Bug fixing, resolving IE pre-v 9 issues, cleanup.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Complete development life cycle with focus on code quality, standards & best practices, testing, build systems.

UX - Identified usability issues in existing application (proposed, produced mockups and prototyped  solutions)
Refactoring - changed existing client application to build under Sencha Cmd (requires resolution, sass/css integration, Ext.Loader)
Build Environment - integrated Sencha Cmd in the Maven build and the automated Jenkins build.
Improved Code Quality - removed overrides, fixed dependencies, implemented best practices, glyphs, sass instead of css

Sencha ExtJS 4, Sencha Cmd, JavaScript, Java, Selenium, SASS (mixins), CSS, Maven, Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development (tools, user-interfaces).

Java, Swing, JavaScript, Sencha ExtJS 4, JAX-RS, REST

positions.title: Principal Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Phase Forward was acquired by Oracle.
Worked on the second major release of the Clinical Development Center to solve numerous user interface problems and correct poor use of technology.

 - Led major re-write of the Metadata tab thereby helping to retain a key customer
 - Put in place best practices for JavaScript and Groovy coding to show developers a ‘better’ way
 - Worked to mitigate XSS holes in Ext JS layer in order to met future product release criteria
 - Introduced heavy use of story boarding, wire-framing, prototyping to explore use cases
 - Driving re-use and encapsulation versus copy and paste

positions.title: Principal UI Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing Phase Forward's Clinical Data Repository (CDR) solution.
Groovy/Grails, Sencha Ext JS, JavaScript

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed a new generation of RIA’s for e-Dialogs’ targeted email solution
 - Recognized both inside the team and outside as an authority on all things UI/UX
 - Re-envisioned existing user management tool for internal system administrators
 - Single-handedly redesigned the main entry point to the Campaign Builder system
 - Improved usability and performance that was recognized internally and lauded by users
 - Led two month consultation period that resulted in 4 UI proposals and a clear winner
 - Developed early working prototype that was exercised weekly by a review panel
 - Promoted modern web-based development and methodology via blog and email
 - Put in place Flex build and test environment, automated builds
 - Worked on QTP integration of custom Flex components enabling QA to test applications
 - Improved ties among Development, Documentation and Marketing
 - Encouraged the team to communicate on wiki, via blog and through email

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal developer in team developing tools for an RFID network device (TAP) delivering across entire product life cycle: requirements, specs, prototype, review, development.

 - Re-implemented the graphical editor with improved libraries that enabled new features
 - Worked with RF engineers to improve algorithms which resulted in improved customer installations
 - Analyzed existing code to find holes and mistakes in algorithm implementations
 - Conceived and implemented many novel features, including Advanced Coverage and Walls
 - Pushed RF engineers to consider 3D modeling of RF to improve accuracy (higher read rates)
 - Led effort to re-factor code, delivering reduced complexity and lower maintenance costs
 - Worked on sales-driven projects to help win orders

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on multiple releases of all Sonic Products, e.g. ESB, MQ, XServer, BPM, and was primary
developer of the Sonic Management Console (SMC).

 - Awarded numerous spot bonuses for “above and beyond” effort to unify tools
 - Delivered big improvements in usability, including wizards, flows and removal of state
 - Spearheaded ‘proof of concept’ that would later move all tools to Eclipse platform
 - Did initial Eclipse plugin development and integration with Extension Points
 - Responsible for de/refining and enforcing style and code standards and mentoring
 - Actively worked to improve quality of products through better testing and ties with QA

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the Progress Software Labs (PSCLabs) group I got to research lots of new technologies with an eye on how we might be able to integrate/leverage into the company's existing products - synergy. Researched search tools, database sync'ing and redundancy, p2p distribution networks, media frameworks and meta (data) attribute systems. Process involved researching, developing small demos/prototypes, documenting, presenting findings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a number of small projects creating websites for customers. This involved alot of HTML, javascript, python and EJB (Enterprise Java Beans) coding. Got my Sun Java Programmer and Java Developer certification.

 - Delivered large-scale integration of 3rd Party Vendor data - HTML, Javascript and Perl script
 - Instituted system for management of version control for developers and customer
 - Client-side integration of data feeds in the browser, fixing browser compatibility issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recruited from the UK deliver new performance and features.
Served as Principal Developer working on GDC’s ProSphere Network Management platform.

 - After detailed analysis, worked with project architect to create new design, solving major issues
 - Helped team members with work decomposition, reviews & standards compliance
 - Presented on behalf of the project at a customer site in the Europe
 - Created data-driven graphical view of slot-based network device

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Started here as a junior engineer and this is really where I learnt my trade - an excellent team and a great learning environment. Writing network management applications in C/C++ running under Windows 3.1 I helped document, extend and improve a proprietary user interface library that provided some portability to Unix platform. I extended and refactored some existing device management tools before being let loose on new product development. My last task involved a substantial re-work of the main application framework "TrueView" to modernize it, providing better functionality and more control.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: First job out of university, I got stuck (for reasons unknown to me) in MoD (military) projects in testing/acceptance phases of development. I was responsible for maintaining test databases, specifying and writing unit tests, etc. Fun times.
